name: Keep Time 85A - Natural
description: 85A drumsticks are a versatile drumstick size that combines the characteristics of a 7A and a 5A drumstick, making them slightly slimmer and lighter than a standard 5A while still providing excellent control and durability. They are often referred to as a "diet 5A" because they offer a lighter touch without sacrificing balance
features: Tip Shape: Teardrop-shaped, providing clear cymbal articulation and warm drum tones

name: Keep Time 55A - Natural
description: A 55A drumstick is essentially a hybrid between a 5A and 5B drumstick. It is designed for drummers who find a 5A too light but a 5B too heavy.
features: Feel: More substantial in the hands than a 5A, with added power and durability
Applications: Rock, pop, gospel, contemporary worship, funk, and heavier styles that require more volume and projection
